scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
actual_behavior: 10-line installed Bash script ignores its own arguments and invokes ${prefix}/bin/mcinspect --kernel=${MCKERNELDIR}/mckernel.img --ps; no independent ps/proc parsing, options or filtering

reuse.consumer: continue invoking installed mcinspect --ps unchanged; do not copy unrelated crash/mcstat format helpers

candidate: 68-line no_std Linux x86_64 Rust C-main object; libc posix_spawn/waitpid with inherited descriptors/environment; configured prefix/kernel path compiled in; no custom shell runtime body
external_dependencies: existing installed mcinspect implementation and its current dependencies, including BFD shim debt owned by lane3

preservation.streams: child stdin/stdout/stderr inherited without parsing or formatting
preservation.signal_status: 128+signal implementation prepared; exact original Bash status/diagnostic parity unproven
preservation.missing_and_permission_errors: C-locale line10 diagnostic and127/126 implementation prepared, untested
preservation.no_direct_proc: actual process enumeration remains existing mcinspect Rust; no direct Linux ps command or /proc interface introduced

remaining_exact_parity_boundaries: Bash signal-death stderr line is NOT implemented/accepted; two full parity cases intentionally remain in the matrix to expose actual difference. Fix only from retained executable evidence; do not exclude failed cases for PASS.

Legacy configured paths with whitespace, wildcard or shell syntax undergo shell evaluation/splitting; Rust proposal restricts literal configured paths instead of embedding a shell. Needs scope/contract review for supported install prefix.
Invalid non-native executable replacement files, missing shebang interpreters and Bash ENOEXEC fallback are not replicated; actual supported mcinspect must be a valid installed executable.
Non-C localized Bash diagnostics, resource-exhaustion fork/spawn retries and unexpected wait ownership errors need explicit contract/native evidence if in supported acceptance scope.

fixture.normalization: Only dynamic worker PID at the exact Bash diagnostic prefix is normalized for comparison; raw captures retained. No signal result/diagnostic is ignored.
fixture.records: Synthetic process rows/header/empty/binary streams only; no real /proc, devices or McKernel image reads.
fixture.isolation: Private configured prefix with Python mcinspect test executable; equal logical mcps symlink invocation switches original/Rust in isolated output. No external application writes.
fixture.ownership: Driver after --execute admits PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER for itself, starts each compiler/CLI in an owned process group, captures/joins leader and verifies group gone; timeouts or adopted descendants kill/reap and fail, never retry. Admission and actual retirement not yet exercised.
fixture.retention: fixture-output existence causes refusal; raw outputs/traces, commands, ownership and final summary retained; original failures never overwritten

selector.edits: Replace configure_file(mcps.in mcps @ONLY), remove only mcps install(PROGRAMS) item, add Rust target/install and mcinspect build dependency; no fallback shell runtime in default profile
selector.shared_file_owner: root coordinates executer/user/CMakeLists.txt with lane3 BFD selector work; proposal only

validation_performed: /usr/bin/python3 -I fixture/run_equivalence.py preparation-only path passed with23 cases and2 open signal parity cases; no compilers or fixtures run
retained original compared byte-for-byte with canonical source; no source hashing
